name: ehs-claude-cli
description: Lock file for the one third-party tool the release workflow runs: the Claude Code CLI, used for `plugin validate --strict` and `plugin tag --dry-run`. It exists so the workflow can install with `npm ci` instead of `npm install -g <pkg>@<version>`: a version tag resolves to whatever the registry serves that day, a lock file resolves to a recorded integrity hash. Nothing in this repository imports it; there is no source here to build.
